units.source_text: 近年来又恢复了在岚山河流上泛龙舟的迦陵频伽 [3] 和在上贺茂神社院内小河上举行的曲水宴等仪式。

en.t: In recent years, ceremonies have also been revived, such as the Karyobinga dragon-boat procession on the river at Arashiyama [3] and the winding-stream banquet held on the small stream within the grounds of Kamigamo Shrine.

units.source_text: 这些都是当年王朝贵族的高雅游乐。

en.t: All of these were refined amusements of the court nobles of that time.
